$comment: nodes=modules, edges=[cause,effect] where cause is imported-by effect. ADD invariants by hand.

invariants.inward-only-dependencies: No module under backend/core/** imports any other backend package, and no backend package imports a package that is farther from core than itself (ADR-002's modular-monolith dependency rule); verify with an import-linter contract run over backend/ that fails on any outward-to-inward violation.
invariants.hmac-verified-before-any-work: backend/webhook_receiver/validator.py's signature check runs and passes before backend/webhook_receiver/router.py enqueues a job or invokes any handler; verify by tracing that every code path reaching job_queue.enqueue() in the webhook handler is preceded by a successful validate_signature() call, and that no other entry point can reach enqueue() for GitHub events.
invariants.budget-guard-hard-blocks: backend/economics/budget.py's BudgetGuard.check() is called at the start of every specialist agent node in backend/orchestrator/nodes.py, and raises/short-circuits the node before any call into backend/tools/llm_client.py once the day's cost (read from the agent_health_1m rollup or its local-dev equivalent) exceeds the configured daily cap; verify no orchestrator node calls llm_client without a preceding BudgetGuard.check() in the same function body.
invariants.events-table-append-only: Rows written to agent_events (or its local pre-Tiger-Cloud equivalent table) are only ever inserted, never updated or deleted, by application code; verify by grepping backend/ for UPDATE/DELETE SQL or ORM .update()/.delete() calls targeting the events table/model, expecting zero matches outside migrations/.
